speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand what's causing the bleeding, how long have these episodes of nosebleeds and petechiae been occurring? Also, have you noticed any bleeding from the gums or unusual bruising elsewhere on the body?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the child have a history of recurrent infections, and have you noticed any unusual bleeding following minor cuts or dental work? I would also like to know if there is any family history of bleeding disorders or if the child has had any recent illnesses or vaccinations.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Frequent epistaxis. I also have Mucous membrane bleeding, Diffuse petechiae on distal extremities.
